newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - SEPT 17.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - SEPT 17.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A day of political debates on the government's performance in the past two years is being held today in the Parliament.
- "The NATO is present in Hungary, but Hungary is not yet present in the NATO" quotes a Begian daily Hungarian President Arpad Goncz now on official visit to Brussels.

- According to informations of National Federation for Hungary, Free Democrat president Ivan Peto will be relieved by Balint Magyar at the party's November assembly. Free Democrats call it an unserious rumour.
- Radio Kossuth quotes the British foreign minister, saying that non of the candidates to join the European Union meets yet the requirements.

- Representants of employers and employees at the Interest Coordination Council blame the government for the significantly higher than planned inflation and are not satisfied with the economic processes in 1996. - Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
